head: 7dce543c41a4b2fd9f00a7546480eb369bc55eba
root_cause: The non-dry-run archive transaction created openspec/.specnav/archive.lock before canonical Verification reconstruction, and Git cleanliness treated the owned transient lock as an untracked worktree change.
resolution: Ignore only /openspec/.specnav/archive.lock/ as ephemeral transaction state while retaining dirty-worktree rejection for every other path.
